description: Join two mate connectors with a mate: FASTENED, REVOLUTE, SLIDER, CYLINDRICAL, PLANAR, and so on. Each connector is an assembly-level mate connector's feature id, or a Part Studio mate connector given as {path: [instance id], connector: feature id} from onshape_get_assembly. The mate's value measures the first connector against the second, so list the moving part first.

connectors.description: The mate connectors to join, moving part first.

anyOf.description: Feature id of an assembly-level mate connector.
A mate connector defined in the Part Studio, as onshape_get_assembly lists it.

connector.description: Part Studio mate connector id, e.g. "FabC_0.mcPinion" (parts[].mateConnectors[].featureId).

path.description: Occurrence path of the instance that owns the connector, e.g. [instance id].

elem.description: Element id (tab) — the <elem> segment of the document URL.

validate.description: Re-read the feature list afterwards and fail if the feature regenerated with an error (default true).

ws.description: Workspace id — the <ws> segment of the document URL.

name: onshape_assembly_mate
title: Add a mate
